subject: SE technical demo scheduling - Acme Retail

Subject: SE technical demo scheduling - Acme Retail

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the interest — excited to get a technical session scheduled with your platform and security teams so our SEs can walk through integration patterns and performance expectations. Proposed goals for the session:

- Walk through Acme's integration architecture and data flow
- Live demo of inference + KV cache + batching behavior for your expected qps
- Security/compliance overview (SOC2, data handling, network options)
- Open Q&A and next steps / mutual action items

Attendees from our side: Jordan Blake (Lead SE), Alex Martinez (Inference Engineer), myself (AE).

A few time options next week (PST):
- Tue 5/19 10:00–11:30am
- Wed 5/20 1:00–2:30pm
- Thu 5/21 9:00–10:30am

If none of these work, tell me a couple slots that do and we'll try to accommodate. I've attached a short agenda and SOC2 summary for your security review.

Thanks —
Marissa

Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

A couple requests from security:
- Can you share SOC2 details and whether you host customer data in customer-specific VPCs or multitenant?

Looping Ethan and Priya — Priya, procurement may have a 15–20 minute slot after the demo to discuss contracting/terms.

> Thanks Marissa. Wed 5/20 1:00–2:30pm (PST) looks promising for us. Can you make it 90 minutes?

Thanks — 90 minutes works for us. Confirming: Wed 20 May 2026, 1:00–2:30pm PST. I've included Dev Patel (Platform SE) who will help with infra/network questions, and Alex who will cover runtime/latency/quantization detail.

Attached SOC2-summary.pdf and a short note on network requirements (see below):
- Outbound HTTPS to redwood.ai endpoints (443) is sufficient for hosted API.
- For Private/Dedicated deployments we provide VPC peering options and fixed IPs; we can share IP ranges during setup.

I'll send a calendar invite once everyone confirms. Also, Priya — we can keep procurement on the brief call after the demo; I'll add a DocuSign link for our standard MSA draft so procurement can start review in parallel.

Best,
Marissa

Happy to join Wed 1:00–2:30pm PST — I'll plan for a 75–90 minute walkthrough. Proposed flow from SE side:

1) 15 min — Acme architecture & objectives (Liam/Ethan)
2) 30–35 min — live demo: sample workload, batching, and KV cache behavior at your expected qps
3) 15 min — latency/cost tradeoffs & recommended quantization/profiles
4) 15–20 min — security/network, handoff to Dev for infra specifics
5) remaining — Q&A and next steps

If there are any specific test prompts or datasets you want us to exercise, please drop them to me ahead of time.

—Jordan
